preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is an integer between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges) and len(set((u, v) for u, v in edges)) == n - 1
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n-1 edges forming a tree (undirected, connected, acyclic) with nodes numbered from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a) and len(set(a_i for a_i in a if a_i != 0)) <= n
preconditions.description: The last line contains exactly n integers a_i, where each a_i is either 0 (dropped) or a unique label between 1 and n (inclusive). No label appears more than once in the non-zero entries.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i == 0 or a_i == j for j in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each non-zero a_i is a valid label from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 1000000007 (10^9+7).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' or (all(a_i == 0 or a_i == j for j in range(1, n + 1)) and all(a_i == 0 or a_i not in {a_k for k in range(1, n + 1) if k != i and a_k != 0} for i in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: If the output is non-zero, the given a_i values are consistent with some permutation of labels 1..n (no duplicate labels in non-zero entries).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' or (stdout == str(count_possible_configurations(n, edges, a)) and count_possible_configurations(n, edges, a) % 1000000007 == int(stdout))
postconditions.description: The output is the number of valid configurations modulo 1000000007, where a valid configuration is a permutation of labels 1..n such that: (1) the permutation can be obtained by swapping decorations along some ordering of the tree's edges, and (2) the given a_i values match the permutation at their respective nodes (a_i=0 means the label is unknown).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if any(a_i != 0 and a_i == j and j != i for i in range(1, n + 1) for j in range(1, n + 1)) else True
postconditions.description: If any non-zero a_i is equal to its node index i, the output is 0 (since no swap sequence can leave a label in its original position if it was swapped at least once).
